rationale: Class 3 anchor triangulation shows the extracted fair-value total of 8,632.315 million equals the filing schedule total and the balance-sheet investment total. The aggregate source value likewise reconciles at disclosed precision. The 25% violation rate therefore reflects an identity check that is too strict for source rounding, not erroneous extracted values.
